title: 纽约审计长呼吁Anthropic暂缓IPO 聚焦AI安全治理
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's talk a bit about Anthropic. We're learning that it had 16.8 billion in quarterly revenue last quarter.
segments.zh: 我们来聊聊Anthropic。据悉其上一季度营收达168亿美元。

segments.en: And then this morning, a letter from the New York City Comptroller hitting Daryon Bade's desk.
segments.zh: 今早，纽约市审计长的一封信送到了Dario Amodei的办公桌上。

segments.en: Nice. And we see here the Comptroller of New York City saying, I write to Urge Anthropic to pause its planned IPO until the company, fully and transparently
segments.zh: 我们看到纽约市审计长表示，我写信敦促Anthropic暂停其IPO计划，直到公司全面透明地

segments.en: addresses this artificial intelligence safety governance and development pays concerns its raised.
segments.zh: 解决人工智能安全治理与发展方面的关切。

segments.en: Instead of proceeding headlong with the IPO, the company should focus its energies on addressing these unprecedented risks.
segments.zh: 与其贸然推进IPO，公司应集中精力应对这些前所未有的风险。

segments.en: But what do you make of this letter being sent? How does it coupled with, again, the revenue number I mentioned just a moment ago, kind of changed if at all it's calculus heading into this IPO.
segments.zh: 你如何看待这封信？结合我刚才提到的营收数字，这是否改变了其IPO的考量？

segments.en: Yeah, the New York City Comptroller focused on an IPO pause so they can address safety.
segments.zh: 纽约市审计长关注的是暂停IPO以解决安全问题。

segments.en: In equity markets, including core weave, there's a lot of downward pressure, frankly from disappointment on the numbers that Bloomberg and others reported coming out of the investor
segments.zh: 在权益市场中，包括核心织网，存在很大的下行压力，坦率地说，源于对彭博等报道的市场参与者
昨日在旧金山会议上的数字感到失望。

segments.en: And it's not necessarily that the numbers came out in and of themselves.
segments.zh: 并不一定是数字本身的问题。

segments.en: It's them trying to piece together limited information they have.
segments.zh: 他们正试图拼凑有限的信息。

segments.en: So what we know is in third quarter, revenues were $16.8 billion, which represents quarter on quarter-grow 45%, Q2 revenues were $11.6 billion, but in that period, Q2, they were
segments.zh: 我们知道第三季度营收为168亿美元，环比增长45%，第二季度营收为116亿美元，但第二季度同比增长147%。

segments.en: up 147%. In other words, there's some deceleration.
segments.zh: 换句话说，增速有所放缓。

segments.en: They also said that they were profitable on an adjusted basis.
segments.zh: 他们还表示，按调整后基准计算，公司已实现盈利。
